# witness-kit

> Wire a mutation gate into any repo, honestly: pairs proven CLEAN with the exact pinned invocation before any workflow ships; existing mutators get the missing discipline (read the score, refuse below it); theatre refused by name. Witness 40/44+4 argued. MIT.

witness-kit is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
